title: Duplicate delivery: replayed event and replayed payment
summary: The baseline record is delivered twice (same event ID) and the payment request is re-sent with a new event ID but the same payment ID. Versions do not double-count and there is still exactly one logical review.

steps.label: Supplier baseline
steps.caption: Northstar Logistics: three-year relationship, established account •••• 1842.

steps.label: Same baseline record, delivered again
steps.caption: The exact same record (same event_id) is delivered a second time, as an at-least-once pipeline may do.
steps.notice: Flink drops it by event ID before touching any version, so there is no new output to observe. The next step proves it: the change becomes v2, not v3.

steps.label: Beneficiary change
steps.caption: Bank details change to •••• 9077 (simulated CDC-shaped event).
steps.notice: Context v2 (the duplicate did not increment the version).

steps.label: Identity activity
steps.caption: The modification came from a previously unseen device.

steps.label: Payment request
steps.caption: A USD 75,000 payment to •••• 9077 is requested.
steps.notice: MANUAL_REVIEW, one row in payment_reviews keyed by (run_id, payment_id).

steps.label: Payment re-sent (new event ID)
steps.caption: The payments hub retries: same payment_id PAY-NS-0006, new event_id.
steps.notice: Receipt DUPLICATE_PAYMENT_IGNORED. The review row still references the first payment event.
